model_annotations.Bulgarian:
This graph is titled "Hidden State Mean" and displays three separate lines, each representing the mean of a hidden state across different layers of a neural network. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 20, indicating the layers of the network. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" without specified units. The x-axis is numerical and appears to have uniform intervals between the labeled layers.

There are three lines on the graph:
- A dashed blue line represents the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71." It starts slightly above 0, remains relatively flat and stable as it progresses across the layers, maintaining close to 0.71 mean value until the final layer.
- A dotted red line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05." This line begins around the 15-layer mark, and unlike the dashed blue line, it remains consistently low, indicating a lower mean value of 0.05 throughout the layers where it is present.
- A solid green line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." It follows a similar pattern to the blue and red lines, starting near the 15-layer mark. This line remains close to the 0.04 mean value with no significant fluctuations.

The graph does not show any clear connections or data points that suggest trends or patterns requiring interpretation beyond the described visual data.
model_annotations.Chinese: The line chart is titled "Hidden State Mean" and it illustrates the hidden state mean values across different layers of a model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the number of layers, starting from "0" and incrementing by 5 up to "20." The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," shows the absolute mean values, starting from "0" and increasing by increments of 1 up to "4." There are three distinct lines on the graph: a dashed blue line, a dotted red line, and a solid green line. The dashed blue line represents the hidden state mean before the gate with an average (avg) value of "0.71," starting from a value near "0" and showing a gradual increase that becomes more pronounced after layer "15," reaching its peak near layer "20." The dotted red line represents the hidden state mean after the gate with an average value of "0.05," maintaining a consistent low value close to "0.04" across all layers, indicating a stable mean after the gate. The solid green line represents the hidden state mean of the baseline, also with a consistent average value of "0.04" throughout the layers. There are no data points marked on the axes other than the starting value for each line at layer "0."
model_annotations.English: The plot is titled "Hidden State Mean" and visually represents the average values of a hidden state, which could be from a neural network or some other computational model, across different layers labeled on the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis, indicating the layer of the model, is linear in scale, with values ranging from 0 to 20, and has numerical tick labels that are regularly spaced, as far as the scale type is concerned. The vertical axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and is a continuous linear scale, likely representing the magnitude of the states, although the specific units are not provided. The plot features three lines, each representing a different state mean: the dashed line indicates the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," the dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," and the solid line corresponds to the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04." The dashed line starts at an average of 0.71 on layer 0 and increases sharply to a peak, then drops and rises again, reaching its highest point at layer 20. The dotted line is mostly flat, suggesting minimal change across layers, with an average of 0.05, situated between the dashed and solid lines throughout the graph. The solid line remains almost constant, only showing slight fluctuations, with an average of 0.04, indicating the most stable mean value.
model_annotations.German: Dieses lineare Diagramm, intituliert "Hidden State Mean", präsentiert drei verschiedene Relationen der Absumme geworden hidden states durch eine Methode. Die x-Achse, mit dem Titel "Layer", zeigt eine Sequenz der hidden states und variiert von 0 bis ungefähr 25. Die y-Achse, mit dem Titel "Abs Mean", repräsentiert die absoluten Werte der hidden states und variiert von 0 bis etwa 4. Es gibt drei Linien in verschiedenen Farben innerhalb des Diagramms: eine blaue gestrichelte Linie stellt die durchschnittliche hidden state vor Gate (0.71) dar, eine grüne gestrichelte Linie stellt die hidden state nach Gate (0.05) dar und eine rote gestrichelte Linie stellt die hidden state der Baseline (0.04) dar. Die grünen und roten gestrichelten Linien beginnen bei ähnlichen Abs mean-Werten, die nahe bei 0 und 0.02 liegen, und bleiben für die größten Teile der hidden states bei stationären oder einfachen linearen Wachstumsmustern. Im Gegensatz dazu zeigt die blaue gestrichelte Linie, die die hidden state vor Gate darstellt, eine dramatische Zunahme vom Beginn bis in die letzten Layer des hidden states, was andeutet, dass die hidden states vor der Anwendung der Gate-Lossfunktion viel größer waren und nach ihrer Anwendung eine drastische Reduzierung erfahren haben, was ein Merkmal des Methodenverfahrens zur regulierung dieser hidden states sein könnte.
